verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אַל־ תַּשְׁחֵ֑ת מִזְמ֖וֹר לְאָסָ֣ף שִֽׁיר׃ ה֘וֹדִ֤ינוּ לְּךָ֨׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים ה֭וֹדִינוּ וְקָר֣וֹב שְׁמֶ֑ךָ סִ֝פְּר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ’al- taš·ḥêṯ miz·mō·wr lə·’ā·sāp̄ šîr hō·w·ḏî·nū lə·ḵā ’ĕlō·hîm hō·w·ḏî·nū wə·qā·rō·wḇ šə·me·ḵā sip·pə·rū nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: For the choirmaster To the tune of “Do Not Destroy A Psalm of Asaph A song We give thanks to You O God we give thanks for Your Name is near The people declare Your wondrous works
verses.literalPt: A TI, ó Deus, glorificamos, a ti damos louvor, pois o teu nome está perto, as tuas maravilhas o declaram.

verses.original: כִּ֭י אֶקַּ֣ח מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲ֝נִ֗י מֵישָׁרִ֥ים אֶשְׁפֹּֽט׃
verses.literal: When I choose a time I will judge fairly
verses.literalPt: Quando eu ocupar o lugar determinado, julgarei retamente.

verses.original: נְֽמֹגִ֗ים אֶ֥רֶץ וְכָל־ יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ אָנֹכִ֨י תִכַּ֖נְתִּי עַמּוּדֶ֣יהָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.literal: When the earth and all its dwellers quake it is I who bear up its pillars Selah
verses.literalPt: A terra e todos os seus moradores estão dissolvidos, mas eu fortaleci as suas colunas. (Selá.)

verses.original: אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַֽ֭הוֹלְלִים אַל־ תָּהֹ֑לּוּ וְ֝לָרְשָׁעִ֗ים אַל־ תָּרִ֥ימוּ קָֽרֶן׃
verses.literal: I say to the proud Do not boast and to the wicked Do not lift up your horn
verses.literalPt: Disse eu aos loucos: Não enlouqueçais, e aos ímpios: Não levanteis a fronte;

verses.original: אַל־ תָּרִ֣ימוּ לַמָּר֣וֹם קַרְנְכֶ֑ם תְּדַבְּר֖וּ בְצַוָּ֣אר עָתָֽק׃
verses.literal: Do not lift up your horn against heaven or speak with an outstretched neck
verses.literalPt: Não levanteis a vossa fronte altiva, nem faleis com cerviz dura.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א מִ֭מּוֹצָא וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב וְ֝לֹ֗א מִמִּדְבַּ֥ר הָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō mim·mō·w·ṣā ū·mim·ma·‘ă·rāḇ wə·lō mim·miḏ·bar hā·rîm
verses.literal: For exaltation comes neither from east nor west nor out of the desert
verses.literalPt: Porque nem do oriente, nem do ocidente, nem do deserto vem a exaltação.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים שֹׁפֵ֑ט זֶ֥ה יַ֝שְׁפִּ֗יל וְזֶ֣ה יָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm šō·p̄êṭ zeh yaš·pîl wə·zeh yā·rîm
verses.literal: but it is God who judges He brings down one and exalts another
verses.literalPt: Mas Deus é o Juiz: a um abate, e a outro exalta.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כ֪וֹס בְּֽיַד־ יְהוָ֡ה וְיַ֤יִן חָמַ֨ר׀ מָ֥לֵא מֶסֶךְ֮ וַיַּגֵּ֪ר מִ֫זֶּ֥ה אַךְ־ שְׁ֭מָרֶיהָ יִמְצ֣וּ יִשְׁתּ֑וּ כֹּ֝֗ל רִשְׁעֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵō·ws bə·yaḏ- Yah·weh wə·ya·yin ḥā·mar mā·lê me·seḵ way·yag·gêr miz·zeh ’a·ḵōš- šə·mā·rê·hā yim·ṣū yiš·tū kōl riš·‘ê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For a cup is in the hand of the LORD full of foaming wine mixed with spices He pours from His cup and all the wicked of the earth drink it down . . . to the dregs
verses.literalPt: Porque na mão do SENHOR há um cálice cujo vinho é tinto; está cheio de mistura; e dá a beber dele; mas as escórias dele todos os ímpios da terra as sorverão e beberão.

verses.original: וַ֭אֲנִי אַגִּ֣יד לְעֹלָ֑ם אֲ֝זַמְּרָ֗ה לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.literal: But I will proclaim Him forever I will sing praise to the God of Jacob
verses.literalPt: E eu o declararei para sempre; cantarei louvores ao Deus de Jacó.

verses.original: וְכָל־ קַרְנֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֲגַדֵּ֑עַ תְּ֝רוֹמַ֗מְנָה קַֽרְנ֥וֹת צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl qar·nê rə·šā·‘îm ’ă·ḡad·dê·a‘ tə·rō·w·mam·nāh qar·nō·wṯ ṣad·dîq
verses.literal: All the horns of the wicked I will cut off but the horns of the righteous will be exalted
verses.literalPt: E quebrarei todas as forças dos ímpios, mas as forças dos justos serão exaltadas.
